All tests pass. 

The fix is a one-line change on line 1832 of `xarray/core/computation.py`. The `keep_attrs=True` lambda was `lambda attrs, context: attrs[1]`, which assumes the second argument (`x`) is always an xarray object with attrs. When `x` is a scalar, `_all_of_type` filters it out, so the `attrs` list has fewer than 2 entries, causing `IndexError`. The fix adds a bounds check: `attrs[1] if len(attrs) > 1 else {}`.
